archive.format: USTAR entries sorted by path, regular files mode 0644, uid/gid/mtime zero, empty owner names; gzip level 9, mtime zero, no filename header

limits: This archive qualifies the two declared native fill workflows, not every spreadsheet operation.
The renderer is LibreOfficeDev 26.8.0.0.alpha0; native XML identity checks and schema checks are separate from its rendered appearance.
No gradient painting capability in the Quds editor is claimed.
This is not a fresh full engine/editor/application gate, browser/device acceptance, or proof that scalar PDF-border/lock state is serialized to XLSX.
The saved-byte reports retain their original paths and bytes. Source identity is recorded at collection and is not misrepresented as a retroactive start-of-run manifest.
